name: Aura Chat Button — Click to Chat and Support for WooCommerce
author: Aura Plugin

sections.description:
Transform Visitors into Customers with Aura Chat

Are you losing potential sales because customers can’t get quick answers? Aura Chat Button is the comprehensive WooCommerce conversion tool that bridges the gap between you and your customers. Unlike standard chat tools, Aura is designed with Sales Psychology in mind—creating a premium, trustworthy communication channel that encourages users to ask questions and buy.

We don’t just add a button; we add a 24/7 Virtual Sales Assistant to your store. Manage customer inquiries, automate offline responses, and track your success with our professional analytics dashboard.

🚀 Why E-Commerce Leaders Choose Aura?

  • Skyrocket Conversion Rates: Direct line of communication on Product Pages removes purchase anxiety and boosts sales.
  • Zero Impact on Site Speed: Built with TinyPNG compression and asynchronous loading, ensuring your Core Web Vitals and Google rankings remain excellent.
  • Intelligent Customer Context: Automatically captures the Page Title and Product URL, so your agents know exactly what the customer is looking at before they even ask.
  • Global Reach Ready: Fully localized for international markets with RTL support (Arabic, Hebrew) and multi-language capability.

💎 Exclusive Premium Features (Free Forever)

  • Smart Scheduling System: Never miss a lead. Set your business hours and let the “Offline Mode” collect messages when your team is sleeping.
  • Visual Excellence: 6 Stunning, Glassmorphism-styled 3D buttons that adapt to your brand’s aesthetic, making your site look expensive and professional.
  • Data-Driven Growth: Built-in Analytics Dashboard tracks every “Chat Open” and “Click”, helping you measure ROI effectively.
  • Device-Specific Optimization: Custom positioning for Mobile vs Desktop ensures the button never blocks your “Add to Cart” button or content.

🌍 Supported Languages (Native Translations)

  • English (Global)
  • Turkish (tr_TR) – 🇹🇷
  • German (de_DE) – 🇩🇪
  • Spanish (es_ES) – 🇪🇸
  • French (fr_FR) – 🇫🇷
  • And 110+ more via localization files.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the aura-chat-button folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. Access the ‘Aura Chat Button’ menu from your admin dashboard.
  4. Configure your contact details and customize your chat button style.
  5. Enable WooCommerce integration or Business Hours as needed.
sections.faq:
Is Aura fully compatible with WhatsApp Business and WhatsApp Web?

Yes, Aura Chat Button offers seamless integration with both personal WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business accounts. It automatically detects the user’s device to open the chat directly in the native app (mobile) or WhatsApp Web interface (desktop).

Will adding this WhatsApp Chat button slow down my WordPress site?

No! Performance is our top priority. We use advanced TinyPNG compression for all assets and load scripts asynchronously. This ensures your site maintains fast loading speeds and optimal Core Web Vitals scores, unlike other heavy chat tools.

Can I use Aura on standard WordPress sites without WooCommerce?

Yes! While Aura is the ideal WhatsApp integration for WooCommerce, it works perfectly on any WordPress website. You can use it on corporate sites, blogs, and landing pages to provide instant customer support.

Why is Aura the preferred WhatsApp solution for WooCommerce stores?

Aura is built specifically for e-commerce. It includes dedicated visibility settings for WooCommerce pages (Shop, Product, Cart, Checkout) and automatically shares the product URL in the chat message, helping you close more sales.

Does the tool offer Google Analytics and conversion tracking?

Yes, it includes a built-in analytics dashboard. You can track every button click, chat opening, and user interaction to measure your conversion rates and optimize your support strategy.

Is it possible to hide the WhatsApp button on mobile devices?

Yes, you have full control over responsive visibility. You can easily show or hide the chat widget specifically for mobile users, or adjust its position and size to ensure a flawless user experience on phones and tablets.

Does the extension support RTL languages like Arabic and Hebrew?

Yes, the design is fully RTL ready. It automatically adjusts the interface for right-to-left languages, ensuring a native experience for your global audience using multilingual support.
